text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"GATE": Tenno Sho (Spring). Past this day, 
Neo Universe might cease to exist. Yet, 
having made it this far, the two of them 
realized something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This race itself carried no risk of 
vanishing. The true "GATE" lay just beyond 
it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In another universe, this was their final 
clash. To keep their "connection" from 
breaking, they give it everything they've 
got!
